answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 148113 Country: India Title: What is the exact weight of misqal? Question: What is the exact weight of misqal? Answer ID: 148113 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 450/401/H=5/1438) According to the book Qawaid al-Fiqh (p. 464) and other books, a mithqal is equal to 4.5 masha . As per the present calculation, one mithqal is equal to 4 gram and 374 milligram. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
